names.form: Άγιοι Ευσέβιος, Νέσταβος και Ζήνων τα αδέλφια Νέστωρ και Βούσιρις

death.note: Stated as a reign and never recorded. This folder’s own life says the notice tells nothing of him beyond the company — the three brothers of Gaza, with Busiris, «martyred under Julian the Apostate». The interval is that reign as this corpus already holds it. No year.
